name: Community Salmon Program Grants
summary: Twice-yearly grants for volunteer, community and Indigenous-led salmon habitat assessment, restoration and stewardship projects in British Columbia and the Yukon. The foundation pays up to half of project costs; the rest is matched by funds or in-kind work.

calls.label: Fall and spring intakes
calls.recurring: Fall intake opens early September with an October 15 deadline; spring intake opens early January with a February 15 deadline.

status.quote: Grant intakes occur twice a year in the spring and fall.

recurring.quote: The fall intake opens in early September, and the application deadline is October 15. The spring intake opens in early January, and the application deadline is February 15.

applicant_types.quote: Be led by a volunteer group, not-for-profit, school, or Indigenous government both at the time of application and during the grant period;

geography.quote: Be community-based and take place in B.C. or the Yukon;

window.quote: Grant intakes occur twice a year in the spring and fall.

co_finance_required.quote: PSF will pay up to 50% of the total value of each project, and the rest must be matched by other funds and in-kind donations or work.
